en-US.title: DiningDealz
en-US.subtitle: Find local food & drink deals
en-US.description:
DiningDealz helps you find local happy hours, food deals, daily specials, and limited-time discounts across Ventura, Oxnard, and Camarillo, California.

Browse nearby restaurants, bars, cafes, shops, and attractions. Search by city or venue type, explore deals on a map or in a list, and open a place profile for hours, addresses, contact details, photos, and current offers.

Create an account to save favorite businesses and receive updates. Business owners can create a business account, manage their profile, share offers, and connect with customers.

Listings and offers can change. Confirm details with the business before you visit.
en-US.promoText: Discover local specials, happy hours, and food deals across the 805.
